text.p: Following are the main stories in Friday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore's ruling People's Action Party took 29 of the first 31 seats, the results of which were announced after the general elections held there on Thursday.
- More than 1,500 illegal Indonesian immigrants from around Malaysia were sent home on an Indonesian warship in the first such humanitarian exercise mounted by the republic.
- Raids to purge the country of the estimated one million illegal foreign workers is to be intensified, Deputy Home Minister Ong Ka Ting said on Thursday.
